library.title: Grading schemes
library.intro: A scheme turns points into the grade students see: a percent, a band, pass/fail or a scaled ORT score. Built-in schemes are shared; your own schemes can be used in all your courses.
library.emptyMine: You have no schemes of your own yet. Create one, or duplicate a built-in scheme.

typeSummaries.percent: Shows the share of points as a percent.
typeSummaries.bands: Maps the percent to named bands, such as 5, 4, 3, 2.
typeSummaries.pass_fail: Pass at or above a threshold percent.
typeSummaries.piecewise_curve: Converts the share of points to a scale, like the ORT 60–245.
typeSummaries.lookup_table: Looks up each raw score in a table you paste.

typeHints.points: The grade is the number of points earned (after any late deduction or manual grade). You can add a pass threshold.
typeHints.percent: The grade is points earned ÷ points possible × 100. You can add a pass threshold.
typeHints.bands: Each band starts at a minimum percent. List bands from the highest down; the last band must start at 0 %.
typeHints.pass_fail: The student passes when the percent is at or above the threshold.
typeHints.piecewise_curve: The share of points r = raw ÷ possible is converted segment by segment. The segments must run from r = 0 to r = 1 without gaps.
typeHints.lookup_table: Each row maps a range of raw points to a value. Rows must start at 0, go up without overlaps or gaps, and reach the expected maximum.

fields.passThresholdHint: Students at or above this percent pass.

bands.label: Label
bands.hint: The key is stored with each grade; the label is what students see in their language.

curve.formulaHint: Inside a segment from r₀ to r₁ the value goes from v₀ to v₁; k = 1 is a straight line, k > 1 bends down, k < 1 bends up.
curve.hint: A full score always gets the scale maximum.

lookup.label: Label
lookup.csvHint: One row per line: raw_from,raw_to,value,label (label optional). Commas, semicolons or tabs work; a header line is skipped.
lookup.csvBadLines: These lines could not be read: {lines}
lookup.expectedPossibleHint: If an assessment has a different maximum, the table is still used and the gradebook shows a warning.

common.roundingDefault: Off: values are rounded half up to 2 decimals.
common.percentileHint: Estimates the share of students below this value from a normal distribution with the given mean and standard deviation.
common.thresholdsHint: Flags such as a golden certificate: set when the value reaches the minimum.
common.zeroRawHint: When a student scores 0 points, show this value and percentile instead of the scheme's result (the ORT shows 0).
common.applyToSectionsHint: Applies the scheme to every section's own points, like the ORT section scores.

grade.title: Grading
grade.subtitle: To grade: {n}
grade.manualHint: Grades stay hidden from students until you release them.
grade.noStudents: No students in the course yet.
grade.pickBody: Pick a student in the list to see the work and enter the grade.
grade.feedbackHint: The student sees it when the grade is released.
grade.clearBody: The points and the rubric scores are removed. The hand-in stays and can be graded again.
grade.releaseAllBody: Every graded student sees the grade and the feedback.
grade.quizBody: Open the gradebook to see the scores and to change a grade.
grade.unsavedBody: The unsaved grade will be lost.

gradebook.noAssignmentsHint: Columns appear when you publish an assignment.

myGrades.waiting: Handed in. Waiting for the grade.

accommodations.ortTimePending: Extra time is saved but not applied to ORT exams yet. Extra attempts and dates do apply.

fields.percentHint: For example 25 = a quarter more time.
fields.attemptsHint: Added to the attempts of every quiz.
fields.noteHint: Only teachers see it. Students never do.

dialog.title: Accommodations
dialog.subtitle: Apply to every quiz of this course for this student. The student only sees the longer time and the attempts.
dialog.clearBody: The accommodations are removed from every quiz of the course.

section.title: Accommodations
section.subtitle: Extra time or attempts for a student in every quiz of the course. Only teachers can change them.
section.empty: No students in the course yet.

override.title: Exceptions for students
override.panelHint: Other dates, extra time or attempts for one student on this assignment.
override.subtitle: Only for this assignment. Empty fields keep the usual settings.
override.removeBody: The student gets the usual dates and limits of the assignment again.
override.fallback: Without an exception the student's accommodations apply, then the assignment's settings.

accessCode.title: Access code
accessCode.hint: Students enter this code before they start. Leave it empty for no code.
accessCode.label: Access code
accessCode.rules: 6 to 32 characters: Latin letters, digits and signs.
accessCode.willClear: The code will be removed when you save.

issues.invalid_chars: Use only Latin letters, digits and signs.

accessCode.lobbyHint: Your teacher gives you the code.

errors.access_code_required: Enter the access code from your teacher.
errors.access_code_invalid: The code is wrong. Check it with your teacher and try again.

examTemplates.scrollingLater: "All questions on one page" comes later; new exams use one question per page.

scopeHint.platform: Visible in every course on the platform.
scopeHint.organization: Visible in every course of this organization.
scopeHint.teacher: Only you can use it, in the courses you teach.

picker.hint: A template gives the sections and rules. You add the questions.
picker.none: No templates are available in this course yet.
picker.after: After creating, add questions to each section in the builder.
picker.lockedLine: Structure fixed: sections, times and navigation cannot be changed
picker.navForward: Sections in order, no going back

upgrade.title: Move to the newer template version?
upgrade.effect: The sections and rules change from v{from} to v{to}. Questions stay in sections that still exist; questions of removed sections are removed. Questions that break the new rules are listed, not deleted.
upgrade.issues: Check these questions against the new rules:
upgrade.notAllowed: Only a draft without attempts can move to a newer version.

importFormat.downloadVersion: Download the import format of v{n} (CSV)
importFormat.downloaded: Import format downloaded. Fill in one row per question and import it in the question bank.
importFormat.help: The import format is a CSV file: a header row, then one example row per section. Rows that start with # are skipped. Fill in one row per question.

saveAs.title: Save as template
saveAs.subtitle: The sections and settings of this exam become a new draft template. The exam itself does not change.
saveAs.countsHint: Leave empty for no limit. Exams made from the template cannot be published outside these limits.
saveAs.countInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.
saveAs.countOrder: "At least" cannot be more than "At most".
saveAs.lockHint: When the template is locked, exams made from it keep its sections, rules, navigation and scheme.
saveAs.saved: "{title}" is saved as a draft template. Publish it on the templates page to use it.
saveAs.noOrg: Your account has no organization to keep templates in. Ask the platform admin.

intro.teacher: Your own templates. Use them when you create an exam in a course.
intro.org: Templates of this organization and of its teachers.
intro.platform: All exam templates on the platform.

emptyHint.teacher: Create one here, or open an exam in a course and choose "Save as template".
emptyHint.org: Create a template for the whole organization, or promote a teacher's template.
emptyHint.platform: Create a template that every course on the platform can use.

create.title: New exam template
create.organizationHint: The template is kept in this organization.

fields.title: Template name
fields.titleRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.

editor.jsonInvalid: This is not valid JSON. Check brackets, commas and quotes.
editor.schemeHintShared: Shared templates can use system schemes only.
editor.conflict: Someone else saved this template meanwhile. Reload to get the latest draft (your changes here are lost).
editor.fromVersion: Editing starts from v{n}. Saving creates a new draft; exams keep their version.
editor.draftPending: A saved draft is waiting to be published.
editor.archivedNote: This template is archived: it is hidden from course pickers and cannot be changed. Exams made from it keep working.

publish.title: Publish the template?
publish.effect: The draft becomes version v{n}. New exams use it; exams made earlier keep their version.
publish.unchanged: Nothing changed since v{n}: no new version.

archive.title: Archive the template?
archive.effect: The template disappears from course pickers and cannot be changed or restored. Exams made from it keep working.

lock.title: Lock the template?
lock.effect: New assignments made from it cannot change the sections, times, navigation and scheme. Assignments made earlier do not change.
lock.menuHint: Fix the structure of new exams

unlock.title: Unlock the template?
unlock.effect: New exams made from it can change their structure. Exams made earlier stay locked.
unlock.menuHint: Let new exams change the structure

promote.title: Move the template to the organization?
promote.effect: It becomes an organization template: every course of the organization can use it, and org admins manage it. The teacher no longer owns it. Exams made from it do not change.
promote.done: The template now belongs to the organization.

import.validateHint: Rows are checked against the sections and rules of this draft exam's template.
import.attach: Add the imported questions to this exam
import.attachHint: Each question goes to the section named in its row. Nothing is saved if anything fails.
import.attached: {count} questions were added to the exam.
import.tooManyItems: Section "{section}" already has the maximum number of questions ({max}).
import.tooManyItemsExam: The assignment already has the maximum number of questions ({max}).
import.tooManyItemsGeneric: The section already has the maximum number of questions. Raise "At most" in the template or remove extra rows.

noAccess.title: Exam templates are for teachers
noAccess.body: Templates are made and used by teachers. If you teach, ask for teacher access first.

errors.template_not_found: This template does not exist or is not available to you.
errors.template_not_published: This template has no published version yet.
errors.template_archived: This template is archived. It can no longer be used or changed.
errors.spec_invalid: The template structure has errors. See the list below.
errors.nothing_to_publish: There is no draft to publish. Change and save the template first.
errors.draft_conflict: Someone else saved this template meanwhile. Reload to see the latest draft.
errors.template_locked: This setting is fixed by the template.
errors.template_locked_exam: This setting is fixed by the exam template. Ask the template owner to unlock it.
errors.preset_template_exclusive: Choose either an ORT preset or a template, not both.
errors.preset_not_templatable: ORT exams cannot be saved as templates.
errors.parameter_missing: Choose a value for every template option.
errors.parameter_invalid: One of the chosen template options is not allowed.
errors.display_mode_not_available: The scrolling display is not available yet. Use one question per page.
errors.importer_profile_reserved: The ORT import format belongs to the ORT course template and cannot be used here.
errors.scheme_not_shareable: This grading scheme is private. Shared templates can use system schemes only.
errors.template_upgrade_not_allowed: Only drafts without attempts can move to a newer template version.
errors.not_a_template_assessment: This assessment was not created from a template.
errors.scope_not_allowed: You cannot create or move templates at this level. Ask your organization admin.
errors.section_not_in_template: The section of a row is not in the template.
errors.type_not_allowed_in_section: This question type is not allowed in that section.
errors.passage_not_allowed: That section does not allow reading passages.
errors.type_required: Give the question type: the section allows several.
errors.count_below_min: A section has fewer questions than the template asks for.
errors.count_above_max: A section has more questions than the template allows.
errors.attach_target_mismatch: The questions can only be added to a draft made from the same template version.
errors.format_mismatch: The file does not match the chosen format. Choose the other format.

versions.title: Versions
versions.empty: No published versions yet. Publish the draft to create v1.

examTemplates.lockedSections: The sections are fixed by the exam template: you can add questions, but not add, remove or reorder sections.
examTemplates.lockedSectionFields: Some fields of this section are fixed by the exam template (greyed out). Titles and instructions stay editable.

specForm.defaultsHint: New assignments made from the template get these settings. They can be changed in the assignment.
specForm.sectionsHint: A section sets which questions can go into it. The teacher adds the questions in the assignment.
specForm.keyHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ (up to 40). Used in the CSV import (column section). Empty means no key.
specForm.keyAuto: Make the key from the title
specForm.keyBound: This section's key is chosen when an assignment is created (parameter "{key}").
specForm.parametersHint: A parameter lets the teacher choose a section's key when creating an assignment (for example the subject).
specForm.paramOptionsHint: Comma-separated: lowercase Latin letters, digits and _.
specForm.lockScopeHint: When the template is locked (More actions → Lock), the checked items cannot be changed in new assignments made from it.

lockKeys.sections: Sections: adding, removing, order and keys
lockKeys.rules: Section rules: question types and counts, reading passages

specForm.jsonHint: For the platform admin. "Apply JSON" copies the structure into the form; then save the draft.
specForm.jsonApplied: JSON copied into the form. Save the draft.

specIssues.generic: This value is not allowed. Check this field.
specIssues.extra_forbidden: The template has no such field.
specIssues.string_too_long: Text too long: at most {limit} characters.
specIssues.string_too_short: Text too short: at least {limit} characters.
specIssues.literal_error: Choose one of the offered values.
specIssues.string_pattern_mismatch: Only lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ (up to 40 characters).
specIssues.type: This value has the wrong format.
specIssues.duplicate_key: Another section already has this key.
specIssues.duplicate_param: Another parameter already has this key.
specIssues.timer_needs_forward_only: Section time limits need section-by-section navigation.
specIssues.section_times_exceed_total: The section time limits add up to more than the total time limit.
specIssues.min_exceeds_max: "At least" cannot be more than "At most".
specIssues.positive_int: Enter a whole number above zero.
specIssues.invalid_types: A question type is unknown or listed twice.
specIssues.invalid_rule: This section rule is not allowed.
specIssues.binds_missing_section: That section does not exist. Choose a section.
specIssues.binds_taken: Another parameter already sets this section's key.
specIssues.bound_key_must_be_empty: A parameter sets this section's key, so the key field must stay empty.
specIssues.options_collide: Options are the same as other sections' keys.
specIssues.unknown_scheme: Grading scheme not found or not available.
specIssues.not_shareable: This grading scheme is personal: shared templates can only use system schemes.
specIssues.reserved: This value belongs to the ORT course template.
